name: 44904 · Lexington, OH
findings: ZIP 44904 (Lexington) has 49 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44904 (Lexington) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 44904 (Lexington) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 69% of the typical level).
